But the function get_fibonacci_sequence expects count: number of items to generate. We don't know how many items until 150. Usually Fibonacci starts 1,1,2,3,... But we can decide. Let's assume starting from 0. So count=13. But we can also compute count=14 to include 233? No, 233 >150. So count=13. Let's call get_fibonacci_sequence with count=13. Then we will output primes and Fibonacci list.
